elements.description: An assistant's answer with its sources, citation chips, actions, feedback and follow-up questions.

properties.name: sources
properties.description: The sources the answer cites, numbered from 1 in the order given – [1] in the answer is the first

properties.name: answer
properties.description: The answer text – may grow while `streaming` is set

properties.name: streaming
properties.description: More text is still coming from your model, keep the cursor going

properties.name: animated
properties.description: Stream the text in; false shows it at once

properties.name: speed
properties.description: Words per second while streaming in

properties.name: followUps
properties.description: Follow-up questions offered under the finished answer

properties.name: feedbackReasons
properties.description: Reasons offered after a thumbs down

properties.name: onRegenerate
properties.description: Regenerate: may return a promise – a rejection shows in the last row, and Regenerate can be tried again

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-feedback-change
events.description: The verdict changes (a thumb, a reason, clearing it, a new answer starting over); detail `{ feedback: AnswerFeedback | null }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps `feedback` as it is (controlled use)

events.name: tc-feedback
events.description: A thumb up, or a thumbs down once its reason is picked; detail `{ value: "up" | "down", reason?: string }`

events.name: tc-follow-up
events.description: A follow-up question was picked; detail `{ question: string }`

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: The answer is on the clipboard; detail `{ text: string }`

props.name: sources
props.description: The sources the answer cites, numbered from 1 in the order given – [1] in the answer is the first

props.name: animate
props.description: Stream the text in; false shows it at once

props.name: answer
props.description: The answer text – may grow while `streaming` is true

props.name: onFollowUp
props.description: Called with the follow-up question that was picked

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stop was pressed while the answer was being written

props.name: onFeedback
props.description: A thumb up, or a thumbs down once its reason is picked

props.name: feedback
props.description: The verdict shown – controlled when defined (null: none)

props.name: defaultFeedback
props.description: The verdict on mount when `feedback` isn't controlled

props.name: onFeedbackChange
props.description: Every change of the verdict, including clearing it and a new answer starting over

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the copied text once the answer is on the clipboard
